decisions.reason: The IMU module is an established building block whose design and firmware investment is already sunk, and it fits the platform's migration to newer connectors, so the firm keeps it in the catalogue.
Its dedicated product page is a visible public commitment, and AC voltage sensing supports the announced energy-management direction, so modest sales are read as a temporary ramp-up.
The solid state relay is a cheap, well-integrated complement to the automation line, so withdrawing it after two years cannot be justified.
Launched only in 2024 and requiring its development investment to be justified, the LED control module is given time to ramp up, with any weak results attributed to its short time on the market.
The wallbox remote access service is central to the announced expansion of charging and energy management and builds on the installed base, so management stays committed to it.
